T: Lost in the jungle, found a good sancocho.
D: A shy romance novelist heads to Colombia to rescue her sister and lands in a real adventure.
P: Serve the snacks when Joan finishes her latest novel at her New York flat.
S: Griddled white corn cakes with cheese and a fried tomato and onion hogao

Griddled white corn cakes, crisp outside and soft inside, split and stuffed with melting mozzarella and butter, served with a fresh tomato and spring onion hogao. Mix 300g pre-cooked white cornmeal with 500ml warm water and 1 tsp salt into a soft dough and rest 5 minutes. Shape 8 patties 1.5cm thick and cook in a buttered pan over medium heat for 5 minutes a side. For hogao, fry 3 diced tomatoes and 4 sliced spring onions in oil for 10 minutes. Split the arepas, stuff with 200g sliced mozzarella and a knob of butter and serve with the hogao.
Fried beef and potato empanadas with a green coriander sauce
Corn flour dough wrapped around spiced beef and potato, crimped, fried at 180C until crisp, with a green chilli and coriander sauce.

Mango, pineapple and papaya cut into cups, squeezed with lime, dusted with chilli salt and topped with fresh passionfruit pulp and torn mint. Peel and cut 2 mangoes, a quarter pineapple and half a papaya into long batons. Pack into four cups or glasses. Mix 1 tsp salt with 1 tsp chilli powder and 1 tsp caster sugar. Squeeze the juice of 2 limes over the fruit, dust with the chilli salt, then spoon the pulp of 2 passionfruit over the top. Finish with torn mint and serve cold.
M: Chicken soup with corn, potatoes, cassava and green plantain
Chicken thighs simmered with corn, potato, cassava and plantain, onion, garlic and coriander for an hour until thick, served with rice and avocado.
the run to Cartagena for the final showdown

Whole snapper scored and rubbed with lime, garlic and chilli, grilled crisp, served with Caribbean coconut rice, fried green plantain and a tomato and onion salsa. Score 2 whole 600g snapper and rub with 3 crushed garlic cloves, a chopped chilli, lime juice, oil and salt. Cook 300g rice in 400ml coconut milk and 200ml water, covered, for 15 minutes. Slice a green plantain, fry at 180C until golden, smash flat and fry again. Grill the fish over high heat for 8 minutes a side. Serve with the rice, plantain and a salsa of diced tomato, red onion and lime.
W: Fresh lime jelly set in a mould, with chilled coconut cream and mint

Fresh lime juice and sugar syrup set with gelatine in a faceted mould for 4 hours, turned out and served with chilled coconut cream and mint. Soak 6 gelatine leaves. Heat 300ml water with 150g sugar, stir in the gelatine, then add 250ml fresh lime juice and a drop of green colouring if you like. Set in a mould for 4 hours. Turn out and serve with chilled coconut cream and mint.
K: Joan Wilder's iced coffee with panela cream
Strong cinnamon panela coffee over ice under lightly whipped cream

Strong Colombian coffee sweetened with panela and cinnamon, poured over ice and topped with a float of lightly whipped cream and a dusting of cinnamon. Brew 60g ground Colombian coffee with 1L hot water so it's strong. While hot, stir in 80g panela or dark brown sugar and a cinnamon stick, then cool for 30 minutes and remove the cinnamon. Lightly whip 150ml thickened cream with 1 tbsp of the brown sugar until just thick. Fill four glasses with ice, pour in the coffee, float the cream on top and dust with cinnamon.
